project.name: Destiny OS :: Persistence
project.description:
JPA entities, Flyway migrations, and the methodology registry (DATA_MODEL_AND_RETENTION.md, ADR D7). Unlike destiny-core, this module is deliberately Spring/JPA-aware - the architecture layout in ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md places persistence concerns here precisely so they stay out of the framework-free domain.
Local test verification uses H2 in PostgreSQL-compatibility mode because this development environment has neither Docker nor a local PostgreSQL instance. That is a real gap, not a formality: H2 does not enforce every PostgreSQL-specific constraint. CI runs a genuine PostgreSQL service container (see .github/workflows/build.yml) so migrations are validated against the real target database before merge.
